description: Returns BRAND.md or CAMPAIGN.md for a brand or campaign target, whole or by sections, headed by its updated-at stamp, or the targeting vocabulary a creator search accepts. Target products:<brand> lists the brand's connected TikTok Shop active products with id, title and price, plus Shopify products. Target competitors:<brand> answers who competes with a product: it returns the saved Competitors list, the shop's product titles and the steps for naming brands with a source, at no charge. A campaign target also ends with a TikTok Shop sales section: orders, GMV per currency, the creators who sold and the read date; name "TikTok Shop sales" in sections to load only it. It then ends with a Recent actions section: the campaign token use and the latest action receipts across the web app and connector threads; name "Recent actions" in sections to load only it. Reading a campaign also lists its TikTok Shop target collaboration invites live, including ones sent elsewhere; naming "Recent actions" or "TikTok Shop invites" in sections returns them. A campaign also lists the Google Sheets its brand chose; name "Google Sheets" in sections to load only it. run:<campaign> reads the latest creator search (state, stage and found), run:<campaign>/<run id> one search with its step trace, job:<job id> a background job, invite:<campaign>/<collaboration id> one sent TikTok Shop invite with its creators and who accepted (add /accepted for only those), reminders:<campaign> the TikTok Shop DM reminders of a campaign with who received each or was skipped, tracking:<campaign>/<first day>..<last day> daily views, likes, comments, shares and GMV per roster post, or why tracking stopped, outcomes:<brand> how many creators each TikTok Shop invite left waiting, ended, accepted or with a posted video and its GMV to date, by campaign and by follower, engagement and category band, ad-accounts:<brand>[/<days>] Google Ads cost,impressions, clicks and conversions, analytics-properties:<brand>[/<days>] Google Analytics sessions,users and conversions, orders:<brand>/<first day>..<last day> Shopify order totals, orders:<brand>[/<days>]/ebay eBay orders, 50 newest (Brand Manager only), inventory:<brand> Shopify stock, and history:brand:<brand>/<heading> or history:campaign:<campaign>/<heading> the 20 newest changes of a heading. <days> is <first day>..<last day>, default the last 30 days. Example: target run:spring-launch.Brand and campaign results end with a context line giving each document stamp and its non-empty sections.

sections.description: Optional heading names to return, such as "Target Audience"; omit or pass [] for the whole document. Campaign and brand targets only.

target.description: Campaign/brand name, handle, id, app.storika.ai URL, or targeting-vocabulary; or creator:<campaign handle>/<candidate ids, comma-separated> to open creators of any search of this campaign; one call takes ids of one search, and each roster creator can come from a different search. For a campaign named by URL, use creator:<campaign>/<search id>/<candidate ids, comma-separated>. Creators open only once their search has finished its review step; before that every creator id answers not found. Or a prefixed target as the tool says.
